name: Drive the replay console with its keyboard shortcuts (signed in)
description: Validates the console's shortcuts with focus on the page (they are ignored inside the slider and text fields by design): an arrow key jumps to the next event, 2 picks From above, Space plays and pauses, and the shortcuts dialog lists them and closes on Escape. The ? shortcut is not asserted here: TestSprite's runner did not deliver that key in two runs, while a Playwright run opens the dialog with it.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-console-14+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "10:26 UTC"

Click the plain heading "25 December, minute by minute" in the panel on the right of the 3D view (click "Show panel" first if it is folded) so the keyboard focus is on the page, not on a button, slider or input; keep it there for every key press below
Assert the replay clock jumps to the next event in the list, "10:59 UTC" ("The voyage data recorder starts recording again")
Assert "From above" is pressed (aria-pressed true) in the view switch (data-testid view-switch)
Assert the play button (data-testid replay-play) is labelled "Pause replay"
Assert the play button is labelled "Play replay"
Click the round button labelled "Keyboard shortcuts" at the right of the top bar
Assert the dialog "Keyboard shortcuts" (data-testid shortcuts-dialog) opens and lists "Space" for "Play or pause" and "1, 2, 3, 4" for the views
Assert the shortcuts dialog is closed
